headline: Going Commando reaches 7,100 matches as OpenRAC expands rendering and co-op
summary: Going Commando reached 7,100 of 8,578 functions and 65.83% matched code by size after integrating an 842-function batch and smaller contributions (rac2-decomp#368). Matching means reconstructed code compiles to exactly the original game's bytes. OpenRAC development gained baked environment reflections, clearer level-editor controls, Drone Device fixes and Android native mod support, while co-op mods gained shared unlocks and smoother remote movement. Deadlocked integrated game, network and PAL matching batches, and Up Your Arsenal added six native NTSC-U frontend routines. SDK 1.10.0 and 1.10.1 and Android-capable mod updates were published; the stable launcher's v0.10.0 release remained a proposal opened that day (OpenRAC#116).
